capabilities: Auto-render json and yaml code blocks as a collapsible tree in reading mode
Preview leaf values inline as images, colors, links, timestamps, JWTs, and Base64
Format and validate selected JSON and locate errors
Convert JSON to YAML or to a table/CSV
Render arrays of objects as tables and keep the original source under each preview
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. All processing is local, but inline media previews fetch remote URLs found in the JSON to render them. Documentation also exists in Chinese (README.zh.md); screenshots in the README are placeholders.
problem: Obsidian shows JSON code blocks as plain fenced text, with no way to explore, validate, or convert the data inside them.
summary: Renders JSON and YAML code blocks as a collapsible rich tree with inline previews, plus commands to format, validate, and convert JSON to YAML or tables.
